basis: Provider rates used to ESTIMATE what an analysis cost. Published rates were read from deepgram.com/pricing and ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing on 2026-09-15. This is not a provider invoice.
how_to_change: Edit a rate or add a new dated period, bump pricing_version, redeploy. Never edit a past period in place - add a new period with its own effective_from, so analyses already priced keep the rate that was in force when they ran. A rate that is not a confirmed published price must say confirmed: false, and every bill then says so.

fx.note: A fixed rate chosen by the team, not a live exchange rate. Update by hand.

merged_audio_billed_channels.note: FALLBACK ONLY. Deepgram bills total processed audio: a 10-minute file processed as 2 channels is billed as 20 minutes. When Deepgram reports metadata.channels, that count is billed. This value is used only when it does not. On 2026-09-15 a real stereo file sent without multichannel reported metadata.channels = 1. confirmed stays false until Deepgram's usage export shows that request at 1x its duration.

periods.source: deepgram.com/pricing, pre-recorded, Pay As You Go, checked 2026-09-15. multilingual applies when language=multi.

PLACEHOLDER. nova-2 is not on Deepgram's public pricing page. The nova-3 multilingual rate is used as a conservative stand-in (team decision 2026-09-15). Replace with the rate shown in the Deepgram console.
